let voiceGeneration = 0;
let voiceAttempt = null;
multiplayer.onVoiceConnection = (room) => {
  voiceGeneration++;
  voiceAttempt?.controller.abort();
  voiceAttempt = null;
  multiplayer.setTalking(false);
  multiplayer.setMicPresence(false);
  voice.disconnect();
  voice.stopMicMonitor();
  if (room) connectVoiceAudio();
};
async function connectVoiceAudio() {
  const room = multiplayer.room;
  if (!multiplayer.connected || !room || voice.connected) return;
  if (voiceAttempt?.room === room) return voiceAttempt.promise;
  const generation = voiceGeneration;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const current = () => generation === voiceGeneration && multiplayer.connected && multiplayer.room === room;
  const attempt = { room, controller, promise: null };
  voiceAttempt = attempt;
  attempt.promise = (async () => {
    const cfg = await requestArenaVoiceToken(room, { signal: controller.signal });
    if (!current()) return;
    if (!cfg) {
      voice.status = 'unavailable'; voice.reason = 'no-token';
      setVoiceHudStatus(); multiplayer.setMicPresence(false); return;
    }
    voice.onVoxActive = (active) => {
      if (!current()) return;
      multiplayer.setTalking(active);
      setVoiceHud(active);
      if ($('mpLobby').classList.contains('show')) renderLobbyRosters();
    };
    await voice.connect(cfg.url, cfg.token);
    if (!current()) return;
    voice.startMicMonitor();
    setVoiceHudStatus();
    const announceMic = () => {
      if (current()) multiplayer.setMicPresence(voice.hasMic() || voice.monitorActive());
    };
    announceMic();
    setTimeout(announceMic, 800);
    applyVoiceMode();
  })().finally(() => { if (voiceAttempt === attempt) voiceAttempt = null; });
  return attempt.promise;
}
